tasks.prompt: In which express (npm) release, counting pre-releases, was req.param() first removed? Give the exact version.
In which express (npm) version was req.param() deprecated? Give the version only.
Express 5.0.0 stopped supporting a magic string in res.redirect() and res.location(). Which string? Give it only.
According to the express 5.0.0 release notes, res.status() only accepts integers greater than what number and less than what number? Answer as 'A and B'.
Which CVE does the requests (PyPI) 2.31.0 release fix? Give the CVE id only.
Which CPython version did requests (PyPI) drop support for in version 2.32.0? Give the version only.
requests (PyPI) 2.32.0 fixed a security issue where setting a Session request option to False on the first request carried over to later requests to the same origin. Which option? Give its name only.
In which serde (crates.io) version was support for Emscripten targets on rustc older than 1.40 removed? Give the version only.
In which React (npm package react) version was the useId hook added? Give the version only.
